in_marathi.name: Gururaj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Compassion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gururaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Guru (Lord, Teacher) + Raja (King, Ruler), thus, the name Gururaj translates to 'Lord of Compassion'. This name signifies the one who is the giver of knowledge, wisdom, and compassion.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Gururaj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Guru (Lord, Teacher) + Raja (King, Ruler), thus, the name Gururaj translates to 'Lord of Compassion'. This name signifies the one who is the giver of knowledge, wisdom, and compassion.
